item.task:
# Target
Row: Facility orbit paints 30 fps: labels stop blocking frames. Land three patches on PR 112.
# Change
1. Isolated worktree: `git fetch git@bitbucket-sunbim:sunbim/xmova-app.git +refs/heads/repo-cleanup-2026-11-05:refs/remotes/bb/pr112`; `git checkout -B land-orbit bb/pr112` (verify == f73f78a61); `npm ci`.
2. `git am -3` /home/kom/.omp/wt/t2c449ef6c/m/tmp/orbit/patches/0001-*.patch 0002-*.patch 0003-Defer-resting-body-depth-pass-during-camera-motion.patch. If 0001/0002 are already present in PR 112 content (check `git log bb/pr112 --oneline -30` for 'Keep Facility painting during label batches' / 'Pace target preparation'), skip those. Resolve conflicts preserving both sides; doc/product-requirements.md clauses must not duplicate.
3. Gates in the worktree: `npx tsc -b`, `npm run lint`, `npm run docs:lint-terms`, `npm run test:precommit`, `npm run build`, then Playwright chromium workers=1 on prebuilt preview: e2e/facility-frame-cap.spec.ts and e2e/facility-label-interaction.spec.ts with `--reporter=list,json` into run dir tmp/land-orbit/<spec>/ with report.json, exit-code.txt, served.txt (cwd + HEAD). Known pre-existing label-interaction failures at base: tests at lines 182, 213, 316, 781 - run the same spec on bb/pr112 base build too and report only NEW failures. Kill your preview PID.
4. If no new failures: `git push git@bitbucket-sunbim:sunbim/xmova-app.git land-orbit:repo-cleanup-2026-11-05` (fast-forward only; if remote moved, fetch and rebase, rerun tsc+lint+frame-cap, push). Read back remote head with `git ls-remote`.
# Return
New head SHA, commits added, gate exit codes table, new vs pre-existing e2e failures, remote readback, PID killed.
item.solutionSpace: one fix: apply given patches, gate, push
